AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_P: [PAWN_nameDef] was a minor in the Private Military Company. {PAWN_pronoun} was usually dispatched to carry out frontier missions.
[PAWN_nameDef] was an engineer in the Private Military Company. {PAWN_pronoun} was in charge of management and planting explosives with supernatural powers. That's dangerous.
Maybe [PAWN_nameDef] just had a lot of luck or very good eyesight. {PAWN_pronoun} showed off {PAWN_possessive} skills in the sniper squad.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_H: [PAWN_nameDef] was the hamburger cook until the delivery of human meat patties.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_S:
[PAWN_nameDef] was a chef who used to make sushi at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant.
 {PAWN_possessive} teachers instructions was to touch the rice grains until {PAWN_pronoun} knew the number of grains {PAWN_possessive} was holding. While continuously preparing sushi, {PAWN_pronoun} reached the point where {PAWN_pronoun} could determine the weight of each piece of sushi with an error of no more than 0.1g. Celebrities from all around the world adored her sushi and people lined up every day to taste it. Then one day... A large-scale food poisoning incident occurred at the store where {PAWN_nameDef} was working. The store went bankrupt after being sued by a customer who fell ill due to food poisoning. [PAWN_nameDef] then wandered from place to place and eventually became involved in the frontier development project.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_V: {PAWN_nameDef} was a virtual idol before arriving on the rimworld. {PAWN_nameDef} used a nerdy avatar with glasses but {PAWN_possessive} unique voice didn't suit the avatar. {PAWN_pronoun} was greatly loved by the public. The day before a game festival, {PAWN_nameDef} informed her fans that an NFT fan signing event would be held. On the day of the event {PAWN_nameDef} left the house in excitement but never returned. A fan who imagined {PAWN_possessive} usual avatar went mad when they saw {PAWN_possessive} real face. [PAWN_nameDef] was then abducted without knowing why and fell unconscious.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_L: [PAWN_nameDef]	was a low-class assassin who killed assassination targets by seducing them. {PAWN_pronoun} tried to execute an assassination on the rimworld using {PAWN_possessive} specialty, but the shuttle {PAWN_pronoun} was riding was hit by anti-aircraft fire and crashed. AlienRace.ThingDef_AlienRace|Alien_Miho|: The common ancestor of many Miho species, including the Ordinary, is thought to be a red fox, not a human. ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Middle_PoweredWork: An exoskeleton specialized for working. It doesn't protect the wearer, but even fragile Miho can easyly to carry heavy loads.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_OrnatedOne|: A high-quality traditional dress made of gold and Ebonsilk.

ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_Militia|des: A dress for soldiers. It's not perfect, but it provides decent protection.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_PMC|descrip: A dress for PMC soldiers. It dissipates the shock to some extent.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_Pariah|desc: An anti-psychic suit powered by the mechanites in the user's body. It aims for increased close combat capabilities and perfect user protection.

ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_Hoodie|desc: A warm hoodie. "Where're the pants? I don't know..."
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_OnSkin_Shirt|descr: A cool shirt. "Where's the bottom? I don't know..."

ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Shell_PMC|descript: A sturdy coat that is also waterproof.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Shell_Sorceress|de: A high-quality cloak that stimulates the mechanites within the body.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Special_Magnifier|: A device that allows you to aim more accurately at a greater distance. Good for Miho with poor eyesight.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Special_TacticalAs: An aim-assist device equipped with trajectory calculation, friend-foe identification, and magnification functions.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Special_Glasses|de: Glasses! They not only improve your eye-sight, they also make you look like a smart librarian.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Special_Visor|desc: A semi-transparent visor made of bulletproof material.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Special_Toxmask|de: A gas mask with a cyberpunk-inspired design that is enhanced with a silk filter for better filtration.

ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Under_IndustrialBl: Easy-to-make underwear. Protects your weak legs from the cold.
ThingDef|Miho_Apparel_Hat_MilitiaVegi|de: Helmet given to soldiers. It is even better because it protects your ears. The camouflage-like plants are not for camouflage, but for decoration and snacks.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_S:
[PAWN_nameDef] was a chef who used to make sushi at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant.
 {PAWN_possessive} teachers instructions was to touch the rice grains until {PAWN_pronoun} knew the number of grains {PAWN_possessive} was holding. While continuously preparing sushi, {PAWN_pronoun} reached the point where {PAWN_pronoun} could determine the weight of each piece of sushi with an error of no more than 0.1g. Celebrities from all around the world adored her sushi and people lined up every day to taste it. Then one day... A large-scale food poisoning incident occurred at the store where {PAWN_nameDef} was working. The store went bankrupt after being sued by a customer who fell ill due to food poisoning. [PAWN_nameDef] then wandered from place to place and eventually became involved in the frontier development project.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_V: {PAWN_nameDef} was a virtual idol before arriving on the rimworld. {PAWN_nameDef} used a nerdy avatar with glasses but {PAWN_possessive} unique voice didn't suit the avatar. {PAWN_pronoun} was greatly loved by the public. The day before a game festival, {PAWN_nameDef} informed her fans that an NFT fan signing event would be held. On the day of the event {PAWN_nameDef} left the house in excitement but never returned. A fan who imagined {PAWN_possessive} usual avatar went mad when they saw {PAWN_possessive} real face. [PAWN_nameDef] was then abducted without knowing why and fell unconscious.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_L: [PAWN_nameDef]	was a low-class assassin who killed assassination targets by seducing them. {PAWN_pronoun} tried to execute an assassination on the rimworld using {PAWN_possessive} specialty, but the shuttle {PAWN_pronoun} was riding was hit by anti-aircraft fire and crashed. Thats how {PAWN_pronoun} ended up living on the rimworld.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_M: [PAWN_nameDef] was a cook that served unsavory  meals at the military base.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_S: [PAWN_nameDef] has caused too many medical accidents. {PAWN_pronoun} was kidnapped by the victims with a grudge and sent to the rimworld.

{PAWN_nameDef} was just a salesperson, but after a surgery as surrogate surgeon {PAWN_pronoun} realized what {PAWN_possessive} true calling is. After that {PAWN_pronoun} performed 1382 surgeries so far.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_N: [PAWN_nameDef] is a nurse. Thanks to the unique professional culture of nurses, she learned how to walk a tightrope well.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_M: "It's no naughty massage at all! Just go down one floor to find the naughty ones!"
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_S: [PAWN_nameDef] was a worker at an illegal massage business. It was a massage salon but in reality it was no different from a brothel. One day whe {PAWN_pronoun} was caressing {PAWN_possessive} customer's whole body, drunk with cash stuck in {PAWN_possessive} underwear, the police raided the business. [PAWN_nameDef] calmly escaped from the scene through a hidden exit. While leaving {PAWN_pronoun} put on the customers baggy pants but didn't notice the bag of white powder sticking out of it's pockets. [PAWN_nameDef] unknowingly stole it and thought {PAWN_pronoun} was going home safely. But later {PAWN_pronoun} was arrested after a drug-sniffing dog, which had been following the police, picked up the scent of the drugs. That's how [PAWN_nameDef] was arrested and blamed for the entire drug smuggling business {PAWN_pronoun} was never a part of.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_F: [PAWN_nameDef] was the manager responsible for the furnace's formulation. {PAWN_pronoun} is now unemployed because {PAWN_possessive} blast furnace exploded after {PAWN_pronoun} watered {PAWN_possessive} compound for money.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_G: [PAWN_nameDef] was a gun fanatic. {PAWN_pronoun} opened a gun shop but realized that 95 percent of {PAWN_possessive} customers were just boring hobby shooters. After that {PAWN_pronoun} headed to the rimworld where true gun fanatics live.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_C: [PAWN_nameDef] is a calligrapher. So {PAWN_pronoun} had to come to the rimworld!
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_M: [PAWN_nameDef] loves to dig, so {PAWN_pronoun} became a mining manager. No, really. She also enjoys hanging out with the workers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_B: [PAWN_nameDef] was a famous magic-killer and worshipped as a god by the tribesmen. But {PAWN_pronoun} came here to hide from a famous bounty hunter.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_E: [PAWN_nameDef] likes machines. As much as {PAWN_pronoun} loves machines, they do lack aesthetic.
[PAWN_nameDef] loves machines. {PAWN_pronoun} was even married to one before.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_R: [PAWN_nameDef] is a famous warrior. Maybe it's to maintain {PAWN_possessive} image or {PAWN_pronoun} is simply not good at speaking but {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't talk much.
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef|Miho_Adult_C: [PAWN_nameDef] is a poor fox who was sold to a dirty otaku. {PAWN_pronoun} had to cook, clean, offer {PAWN_possessive}... well... Anyway, {PAWN_pronoun} got tired of this life and fled far away.
